title: Identity of the Future: Planning, Decision, and Responsibility
summary: The frontal cortex is built through decisions. Teach him: (1) Weekly planning: goals, priorities, time. (2) Decision-making: gather information, seek consultation, perform istikhara, decide, monitor the outcome. (3) Responsibility: he bears the consequences of his decision, do not blame others. (4) Vision: Write "Me in 20 years" — what are your values? What do you do? Whom do you serve? Parents: be advisors, not imposers; celebrate good decisions, analyze mistakes without blame.
try_this: This week: Create together a "5-year roadmap" — values, career dream, required skills, steps for this year. Hang it in his room.
reflection_prompts: What was the first practical step you agreed upon?
